laws.rule: Kopaonik National Park charges a vehicle fee at the Đorov Bridge, Brzeće and Sunčana Dolina gates: cars and motorcycles RSD 300 a day, RSD 800 a week, RSD 2,000 a year. Hybrid and electric vehicles are exempt but must send registration proof within 8 days of first entry or the invoice stands. (No RBA rate for RSD; at the National Bank of Serbia rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 73.8203 RSD: RSD 300 ≈ A$4.06; RSD 800 ≈ A$10.84; RSD 2,000 ≈ A$27.09)
